PRIVACY
POLICY.

Last updated: 19 October 2026

← Back to the store
Browser storageEnquiry draftsExternal linksMedia sources

What stays in your browser

The shopping bag, saved products, theme and reading direction are stored in your browser’s local storage when available. These preferences are used by this website to restore your choices on a later visit. You can remove them by clearing this site’s browser data.

Contact and teamwear drafts

The contact and teamwear forms create text drafts for you to download. Their contents are processed in your browser. These forms do not send an email, place an order or create a customer account. A downloaded draft remains on your device until you remove it.

Payments and accounts

This frontend does not provide an account registration or payment process. Adding an item to the kit bag does not purchase it.

Links to other services

Social buttons, map links and media-credit links may open other websites. Your interactions with those websites are governed by their own privacy practices. Opening this site also involves routine network requests to its hosting service.

Photos, video and fonts

Images, video and font files used in the page are served with the site. Native video playback is controlled in your browser. Background motion respects reduced-motion preferences, and the homepage provides a pause control.

Media sources

Equipment and sporting lifestyle photographs are sourced from Pexels, Wikimedia Commons and the linked SCS Sports product listings. They illustrate the catalogue and sporting stories; availability and final specifications should be confirmed with the shop.

“A Modern Cricket Bat” by Arv94, from Wikimedia Commons, is used under CC BY-SA 4.0. The photograph was resized for web display. The resized image retains that licence.

Pexels product photographs: cricket equipment, football, rackets, dumbbell, cricket ball, jersey, court equipment, training mat, classic football, racket detail and hex dumbbell.

Additional branded equipment photographs are from SCS Sports product listings. The product photography source list links each photograph to its reference item. Brand names identify the pictured products and do not imply an affiliation or endorsement. Catalogue prices are illustrative; this site does not confirm stock or process payments.
